scenarios.title: Query network connectivity
scenarios.expected: Clicking 'Check network connectivity' writes 'Current connectivity is <level>.' to ResultsText and, if connected, evaluates cost/connect; else 'Not attempting to connect to the Internet.'

scenarios.title: Get network cost information
scenarios.expected: Clicking 'Get network cost' writes 'Network cost is <type>.' plus an app-behavior recommendation, or 'No internet connection profile.'

scenarios.title: Listen to connectivity changes
scenarios.expected: Clicking the register button subscribes to NetworkStatusChanged, toggles its label to Unregister, and logs registration + current connectivity to ResultsText.
